caption: The drawing features a single garment, depicted in fine black lines on a beige background. The centerpiece is a long, loose-fitting dress with a high, round neckline and long, full sleeves that gather into wide, decorated cuffs. The yoke of the dress, extending from the shoulders down to the upper chest and back, is horizontally striped, with an elaborate decorative vertical placket running from the collar down the center of the chest. Vertical lines suggest pleats or gathers running from this yoke down the front and back of the dress. A smaller secondary illustration in the upper right corner shows the back view of the garment, indicating that the yoke and sleeve construction continue around the back, where the garment hangs loosely to the hem. The drawing is rendered entirely in shades of gray and beige, with no additional color present.
title: Nightgown
